title: Registry protocol v1 + PackageStore trait + EntitlementVerifier (open licensing seam)
description: Gives the inert License fields in fe-format/src/license.rs (LicenseType::Paid, free_entries, encrypted_key, payment_verification_url, payment_provider) real effect, open-source only. Documents registry protocol v1 (versioned by an X-Hexon-Registry-Protocol response header plus a /health protocol_version field; no route prefix) over fe-hexon-registry's existing routes; extracts a PackageStore storage trait whose filesystem reference impl is today's scan_dir/index behavior unchanged; makes auth default-deny (refuse open access unless FE_REGISTRY_ALLOW_OPEN=1, replacing the startup warn-and-continue at main.rs:16-18); defines an EntitlementVerifier trait + ed25519 entitlement token format (pinned issuer keys) in fe-format behind an opt-in entitlement cargo feature + an X25519/XChaCha20-Poly1305 recipient-wrap scheme for encrypted_key; wires decryption into fe-hexon's load path (in memory, ciphertext stays at rest) so free_entries load with no entitlement and licensed entries decrypt only with a valid token; adds Hexon Manager UI states (installed-preview / entitlement-required / entitled); bumps docs/hexon-format-spec.md to 1.1.0. Verification and self-hosted issuance only — no payment code.
alignment: Realises public decision D-12 (format and engine stay open) via conductor/open-core.md's rule: anything a self-hoster needs to run, verify, or extend is open. Defines seams S-REGISTRY and S-ENTITLEMENT (open-core.md §Seams, already naming this track id), which downstream services consume one-way: consumers depend on this repo, this repo never names them.
open_decisions: OD-2 protocol version transport (header vs route prefix vs both)
OD-3 PackageStore trait shape for non-path-based stores
OD-4 encrypted_key wrap scheme + recipient identity
OD-6 issuer key pinning config shape
OD-8 who may mint tokens locally (self-hosted issuer)
notes: 2026-10-31: track drafted (docs only). S-REGISTRY and S-ENTITLEMENT wording must match conductor/open-core.md §Seams verbatim, which already cites this track id and these line numbers (fe-format/src/license.rs:6-27, fe-hexon-registry/src/main.rs:16-18).

This repo is PUBLIC (Apache-2.0). No pricing, revenue, payment-provider integration, or marketplace business logic belongs in any file this track touches — only cryptographic verification/decryption and a trait any downstream service can implement against.

Ground truth confirmed by re-grep @f55ca21: every License literal passes encrypted_key: None — 9 sites across fe-hexon/src/{authz,manifest,package,publisher,registry}.rs plus License::default at fe-format/src/license.rs:39 (10 total); fe-hexon-registry has a SEPARATE, simpler License-free auth model (one shared bearer token, no RBAC) from fe-hexon's in-process authz.rs (Manager+/Owner RBAC via fe-policy) — the two must not be conflated in the spec.

2026-10-31: fresh-context review fixes — (1) fe-hexon-registry depends on fe-format with default-features = false, so fe-format::entitlement (and its jsonwebtoken/x25519-dalek/chacha20poly1305 deps) sits behind an opt-in `entitlement` feature or NFR-3 (registry gains no entitlement dependency) is violated; (2) EntitlementVerifier + LocalIssuer live in fe-format::entitlement (S1) so fe-plugin can reuse them without depending on fe-hexon; (3) one revocation model across S-ENTITLEMENT/S-PLUGIN: licence revocation = short TTL + refused reissuance, the S-PLUGIN signed revocation list = package-level kill switch only (spec §3, §4.5); (4) decrypt at load time with ciphertext at rest, otherwise expiry bounds nothing.
